## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
A new cyclone, Akvan, is expected to move towards the Andhra coast by November nineteenth, with rainfall anticipated in Tamil Nadu and Bengal. This development follows earlier predictions of dry days for Tamil Nadu, as a low-pressure system had been moving towards Sri Lanka. The current forecast indicates a shift in weather patterns for the region, with attention now on the potential impact of Cyclone Akvan.
